PART II

Item 7 - Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Revenue decreased 18% to $4.1 million in 2025 because a key distributor reduced orders. Our net loss widened to $2.3 million and we continue to experience negative operating cash flow.

We will need to raise additional capital within the next twelve months, and there is substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern if such financing is not available on acceptable terms.
